sloka: एवम् श्रुत्वा तु सम्वादम् लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः ।बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः शोकम् सोढुमशक्नुवन् ॥२-३१-१॥
transliteration: evam śrutvā tu samvādam lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ ।bāṣpaparyākulamukhaḥ śokam soḍhumaśaknuvan ॥2-31-1॥

translations.english: Lakshmana who had already reached there heard the conversation (between Sita and Rama). His eyes brimming with tears, he was unable to bear the grief. He held the feet of his brother tightly and said to the illustrious Sita and Rama of great resolve:
